plugins.name: vcs-workflow
plugins.description: Per-prompt version-control workflow reminder for Claude Code (and Copilot/Factory). Detects the repo type (jj-colocated, pure-jj, or pure-git) and injects a scope-classification + push-to-active-branch decision tree via UserPromptSubmit hook. For other clients install vcs-workflow-skill instead.

plugins.name: vcs-workflow-skill
plugins.description: Portable, hook-free skill version of vcs-workflow for AI clients without per-prompt hooks (Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Windsurf, Cline, etc.). Same scope-classification + push-to-active-branch checklist, loaded once at session start. Install via allagents.
